Prompt.title: Prompt
Prompt.description: A user-owned prompt template stored in Firestore with variable placeholders, categorization, target model metadata, and usage tracking.

title.description: Human-readable title of the prompt template.

description.description: Concise summary of the prompt's purpose and expected output.

content.description: The prompt body text, optionally containing {{variable}} placeholders.

category.description: Primary functional domain of the prompt.

targetModel.description: Recommended LLM or model family for running this prompt.

collectionName.description: Named workspace collection or folder grouping.

tags.description: Up to 8 short descriptive tags for filtering.

isPinned.description: Whether the prompt is pinned to the top of the user's library.

usageCount.description: Number of times this prompt has been copied or compiled.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the prompt creator and owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the prompt was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the prompt was last updated.

/prompts/{promptId}.description: Collection storing individual user-owned prompts isolated by ownerId.
